mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signup_requests (id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{status}, datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signup_requests WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signup_requests WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE signup_requests SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
